title: Do As I Do, Not As I Say: On-Policy Distillation Inherits the Teacher in Vision-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.20989v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Improving the reasoning capabilities of vision-language models (VLMs) often relies on post-training with supervision from stronger models. Two common strategies are supervised fine-tuning (SFT), which trains on teacher-generated demonstrations, and on-policy distillation (OPD), which provides teacher feedback on trajectories generated by the student itself. While OPD can be more data-efficient by supervising student-generated trajectories, it is unclear how the teacher's supervision at each state affects the student's learned behavior. To study this question, we conduct a controlled comparison of OPD and filtered SFT across data budgets and tasks where the teacher exhibits different levels of reliability, and analyze how these differences shape student accuracy and completion behavior. translated_title: 照我做的做，而不是照我说的做：视觉语言模型中的在线策略蒸馏会继承教师模型
translated_abstract: 提升视觉语言模型（VLM）的推理能力通常依赖于借助更强模型进行监督的后训练。两种常见策略是监督微调（SFT），即在教师生成的示范上进行训练；以及在线策略蒸馏（OPD），即由教师对学生自身生成的轨迹提供反馈。虽然OPD通过监督学生生成的轨迹可以获得更高的数据效率，但教师在每个状态上提供的监督如何影响学生的学习行为尚不清楚。为了研究这一问题，我们在不同的数据预算以及教师表现出不同可靠性水平的任务上，对OPD和过滤式SFT进行了受控比较，并分析这些差异如何塑造学生的准确率和完成行为。在两个任务上，我们发现只有当教师在学生生成的轨迹上保持可靠时，OPD才是有效的。在ChartQA上，当教师……
tldr: 该研究发现，在线策略蒸馏（OPD）只有在教师模型对学生自身生成的轨迹保持可靠时才有效——学生会直接继承教师在其所处状态上的行为（包括错误），因此教师对学生的状态分布是否可靠是OPD成败的关键。
en_tdlr: This controlled comparison shows that on-policy distillation (OPD) is effective only when the teacher remains reliable on student-generated trajectories, meaning the student inherits the teacher's behavior—including its errors—on its own state distribution.
